description: Lists the indexing requests made for the property (from request_indexing, the panel or the sitemap job), newest first: url, engine (indexnow / google), action, source (manual / sitemap / agent), status (queued, submitted, failed, skipped), queuedAt, submittedAt, httpStatus and error. Filter by status; days = how far back (default 7, max 365). Returns counts per status and per engine, plus the daily credit per route (indexnow and google: used, limit, left; null = no limit). Reads only Organiq data. A sent request is not a confirmation; the confirmed state comes from the inspection (get_indexing_tracker). Use after request_indexing to see what was sent or why a request failed. / Pedidos de indexação da propriedade, com status por motor e crédito do dia.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.
